name: shiv-agentic-plugins
description: Shiv Solutions development plugins for agile workflows, TDD, spec-driven development, and plugin management

plugins.name: shiv-agile
plugins.description: Shiv Solutions agile workflows: create epics, stories, technical enablement stories, bugfixes, auto-groom sprints, score INVEST criteria, and transform notes into work items. Jira integration with configurable defaults.

plugins.name: shiv-dev
plugins.description: Shiv Solutions development workflows: agentic TDD with human checkpoints, JIRA-integrated TDD, Jira-to-Terraform infrastructure pipelines, and automated PR code review

plugins.name: shiv-speckit
plugins.description: Speckit specification toolkit: specify features, clarify requirements, plan implementations, generate tasks, implement with bd tracking, analyze cross-artifact consistency, generate checklists, manage project constitutions, and export tasks to GitHub issues

plugins.name: shiv-tools
plugins.description: Shiv plugin management utilities: sync plugins, check status, detect local overrides, and scaffold new plugins

plugins.name: shiv-design-docs
plugins.description: Design documentation toolkit for Confluence: create Technical Architecture, Detailed Design, ADR, Runbook, and API Design documents from Jira epics/tickets. Supports bidirectional sync, template extraction, and Confluence-native formatting.
